words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) opens the ayah as report, not prohibition: the imperfect verb after it is an indicative predicate, so the clause denies general fire-exposure before it identifies the exception. words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَشْقَى}} ({{tr:al-ashqā}}) is an adjective-form made substantive: no head noun follows, so the definite elative itself becomes the subject, the most wretched person or class. It is not generic misery and not ordinary hardship. The root field supplies misery opposite felicity, hardship, failed striving, and image-pressure of inner rupture, but the local fire-entry restriction selects moral perdition at the extreme. The word foregrounds the state rather than naming a causer, and 92:16 supplies the acts by which that state is reached. Because the word comes after {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), {{ar:يَصْلَىٰهَآ}} ({{tr:yaṣlāhā}}), and {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}), it resolves the entire clause as the only included class. Its definiteness can point to a specific figure while still classifying more broadly; it can gather the withholding, self-sufficient figure of 92:8 and resonate with the defiant same-form use in 91:12. Then 92:16 immediately defines the label by denial and turning away, while 92:17 answers it with the opposed elative {{ar:ٱلْأَتْقَى}} ({{tr:al-atqā}}). The final long sound, rough consonantal texture, and rare superlative placement make the moral extreme arrive abruptly and then linger as the ayah's audible and visible endpoint.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exclusive construction lā yaṣlāhā illā al-ashqā links the verb at word 2 and the superlative subject at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The heat-encounter branches of the split ṣ-l-y mapping combine with both experiential hardship and wretchedness in the split sh-q-w mapping. The clause therefore identifies an extreme condition through exclusive, endured contact, not merely by attaching a moral adjective to an otherwise unspecified person.

activation_trace.role: Direct exposure to fire or heat supplies the event undergone by the exclusive subject.
The non-dominant split target independently preserves meeting, enduring, or being cast into heat.
Difficulty, fatigue, and strenuous endurance make the superlative an experienced extremity.
Wretchedness opposed to happiness supplies the subject's affective and existential pole.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely says that a person called the most wretched enters an unspecified object.
changed_reading.after: The exclusivity clause identifies extreme wretchedness by the direct ordeal of meeting and enduring the feminine object as consuming heat.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Yaṣlāhā remains anchored in the focus verb at word 2, while al-ashqā at word 4 supplies the arduous subject.
baseline_models.mechanism: A fire-use branch does more than burn: heat can roast or straighten a resistant object. Combined with the hardship branch of sh-q-w, this permits a process reading in which contact is a coercive remaking under heat rather than only arrival at a location.

activation_trace.role: Kindling and turning an object over fire to straighten it supply a material transformation process.
Hardship and toil make that heated transformation coercive and painful.

changed_reading.before: The heat is only a destination or punitive environment.
changed_reading.after: The heat can also be carried as an ordeal that works upon its subject, painfully straightening or remaking what would not otherwise yield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The superlative al-ashqā and the exception illā form an extremal threshold around the focus subject.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sh-q-w inventories include mutual grappling and prevailing in a hardship contest. Joined to the ṣ-l-y fire encounter, that branch turns the subject from a static type into the terminal participant of a struggle whose finishing condition is exposure.

activation_trace.role: A contest of hardship and its prevailing party supply a relational field for the superlative.
Mutual endurance, handling, and overcoming make wretchedness an outcome of sustained grappling.
The heat encounter supplies the struggle's terminal exposure.

changed_reading.before: The most wretched is a fixed identity named before any process is considered.
changed_reading.after: The most wretched can be heard as the extremal outcome of a contest or sustained struggle that culminates in exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening alternation between a cover laid over things and their disclosure recasts ṣ-l-y as exposure after concealment. The most wretched is not only one who reaches heat, but one left uncovered to it when the cycle turns from veiling to manifestation.

activation_trace.role: Meeting heat supplies the focus event whose degree of exposure is being revised.
A covering that rises over and conceals an object supplies the initial protected or obscured state.
Uncovering and appearance reverse the cover and make direct exposure possible.

structural_cues: 92:1 and 92:2 are paired temporal clauses whose predicates reverse concealment into disclosure.
The focus verb takes a feminine object pronoun, allowing attention to fall on how that object becomes exposed or manifest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cover followed by disclosure; I supply the arrow from disclosure to unshielded heat-contact. A live alternative is that the cosmic pair frames contrast without causing the focus exposure.

changed_reading.after: The subject is the one left fully exposed to heat when concealment gives way to disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured formation is followed by purposeful movement that disperses into separated courses. This sequence activates the process latent in the focus superlative: al-ashqā becomes an extremal endpoint produced or disclosed among divergent strivings, not an unexplained essence.

activation_trace.role: Hardship as sustained practice gives the focus superlative a process that can intensify over a course.
Measuring and proportioning supply formed differentiation without requiring moral fixity.
Purposeful motion toward a sought end supplies trajectory rather than static classification.
Dispersion and separation split the trajectories into genuinely different courses.

structural_cues: The creation pair in 92:3 is followed immediately by the statement that human striving is diverse in 92:4.
Al-ashqā is a superlative, so it can mark the far end of a graded field.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation and divergent purposeful striving; I infer that the focus superlative names a trajectory's extremal outcome. The live alternative is a pre-existing class merely revealed by its actions.

changed_reading.before: The most wretched is an innate, unexplained kind of person.
changed_reading.after: The most wretched is the furthest endpoint within divergent courses of striving, a condition reached or made visible through movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired biographies are each followed by facilitation, even when the goal is hardship. Ease here functions as reduced resistance along a chosen course: withholding, claimed self-sufficiency, and denial become a momentum that smoothly conducts the subject toward the arduous condition named in al-ashqā and finally toward heat-contact.

activation_trace.role: Hardship and toil connect the focus superlative to the difficult destination of the negative course.
Opening and ease after obstruction establish facilitation as a path-making operation.
Withholding supplies the initiating contraction of the negative trajectory.
Claimed independence supplies the self-sealing premise that removes felt need for another course.
Assigning falsehood to the good closes the course epistemically as well as materially.
Lightness and compliance in motion supply the paradoxical smoothness of movement toward difficulty.
Twisting, opposition, and imposed difficulty make the destination a condition that compounds resistance.
Enduring or being cast into heat supplies the terminal event of the facilitated negative course.

structural_cues: 92:5-7 and 92:8-10 form parallel conditional sequences with opposed acts and opposed destinations.
The same causative facilitation verb appears on both sides, including facilitation toward hardship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated facilitation around opposed courses; I infer habituation or path-dependence that lowers resistance in the chosen direction. The live alternative is external assignment to an endpoint without an internal feedback process.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports a punishment attached after the subject has already become wretched.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the terminal phase of a self-reinforcing course: denial is made progressively easier until hardship and heat become the path's fluent destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Claimed sufficiency is tested at the moment accumulated wealth cannot substitute for the person, and the person falls toward ruin. Sequentially, that collapse supplies motion into the focus heat encounter: ṣ-l-y becomes the receiving endpoint of a downward failure rather than an isolated later scene.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency and adequacy establish the function that wealth is said to fail.
Accumulated possession supplies the support that proves unable to arrest the movement.
Falling into ruin supplies a downward transition toward an endpoint.
Direct heat-contact receives the falling trajectory as its terminal condition.

structural_cues: The conditional idhā in 92:11 places the failure of wealth at the moment of falling.
The focus follows the fall, guidance claim, temporal ownership, and warning in a tightening sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed sufficiency, wealth, and a fall into ruin; I supply the directional arrow from that fall to the later fire encounter. A live alternative is that the fall means death or ruin without spatial continuity.

changed_reading.before: The subject independently approaches or enters the heat.
changed_reading.after: The subject collapses into the heat-contact after the support expected from accumulated wealth fails.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gentle indication toward a way is asserted before both the later and the first are enclosed in one ownership claim. The focus exception is therefore read inside an available route and a complete temporal span: the final exposure is not an arbitrary gate but an endpoint after direction has been supplied.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a road or truth supplies an available directional alternative.
Laterness after a first point supplies the far temporal endpoint.
Beginning and precedence supply the near temporal endpoint, enclosing the whole course with laterness.
The wretched pole marks the adverse endpoint reached within that guided span.

structural_cues: 92:12 makes guidance an asserted responsibility before the warning and focus exception.
92:13 reverses ordinary order by naming the later before the first, making the two endpoints conspicuous.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direction and both temporal ends; I infer that the focus outcome is accountable path-completion rather than arbitrary exclusion. The live alternative is that these are sovereignty claims without a causal path model.

changed_reading.before: The exception appears as an unexplained sorting rule.
changed_reading.after: The exception marks the adverse endpoint of a fully spanned course for which direction was made available.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning raises vigilance, an explicitly kindled fire is introduced, and its flame is described as pure and intensely burning immediately before yaṣlāhā. This resolves the feminine object pronoun backward and sharply selects the fire-contact branch while leaving the focus-only alternatives as subordinate resonances.

activation_trace.role: A fear-arousing warning supplies anticipatory orientation toward a specified danger.
A kindled fire supplies the feminine antecedent and the material source of heat.
Pure, intensely kindled flame specifies the fire's active consuming condition.
Entering, suffering, or directly meeting heat realizes the warned object's effect on the focus subject.
The parallel split target confirms combustion and endured heat as the selected event family.

structural_cues: The feminine noun nāran in 92:14 immediately precedes the feminine object pronoun -hā in 92:15.
The two verses form warning-object followed by restricted-contact.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an adjacent feminine fire and a blazing predicate; I infer direct pronoun coreference and branch selection. The live alternative is a broader deictic reference to the warned conflagration, which preserves the same event family.

changed_reading.before: The focus-only feminine object is unresolved and several ṣ-l-y families remain comparably available.
changed_reading.after: The object is the immediately warned blazing fire, and yaṣlāhā is direct entry into or endurance of its heat; the other branches survive only as echoes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following relative clause gives the extreme subject an operational profile: he assigns falsehood and turns his face away. Wretchedness is thus enacted as a coupled epistemic and directional refusal, and fire-contact is the consequence of sustained orientation rather than an opaque personal essence.

activation_trace.role: The opposed-to-happiness state supplies the focus category that the following actions specify.
Attributing falsehood supplies the active epistemic refusal.
Turning away supplies the bodily and directional completion of that refusal.

structural_cues: 92:16 begins with a relative pronoun immediately after al-ashqā.
The two perfect verbs pair a judgment of falsehood with bodily withdrawal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an adjacent relative clause with denial and turning away; I read it as explanatory specification of al-ashqā. A live alternative is an appositive exemplar rather than an exhaustive definition.

changed_reading.before: The most wretched is a condition with no visible generating action.
changed_reading.after: The most wretched is one who repeatedly makes the good false and reorients away from it, thereby enacting the path into exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same feminine object is met by one superlative and actively kept to the side of another. Avoidance is not mere absence: lateral displacement and protective shielding form the inverse operation of ṣ-l-y. The focus becomes one side of a boundary mechanism that routes trajectories into contact or away from it.

activation_trace.role: Direct heat-contact supplies the inward or exposed side of the boundary.
Removal, separation, and keeping apart supply active displacement to the safe side.
Leading something toward the side gives the avoidance a directed spatial operation.
Repelling harm by a protection supplies the functional reason for lateral removal.

structural_cues: 92:15 and 92:17 repeat the same feminine object pronoun with opposed verbs.
Al-ashqā and al-atqā are matching superlative forms on opposite sides of the pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contact, active side-removal, and protection; I infer a single sorting boundary with opposite routes. The live alternative is two independent outcomes described in balanced rhetoric.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a standalone statement that one class enters fire.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the exposed side of a sorting boundary: one trajectory is admitted into contact while the guarded trajectory is actively conducted aside.

context_deltas.mechanism: The positive subject releases accumulated wealth for purification, disclaims any human favor awaiting repayment, and seeks another direction. That sequence activates the focus root's snare branch: the negative course can be modeled as capture inside a self-sealing economy of possession and return, while unreciprocated giving breaks the loop and turns elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: A set snare supplies the focus-anchored image of capture in a mechanism that closes around its subject.
Giving transfers possession outward and supplies the loop-breaking act.
Accumulated wealth supplies the material that can be hoarded inside or released from the circuit.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Encountering fire as exclusive extremity.** Evidence: `ص ل ي` B003 (encountering fire/heat), `ش ق و` B002 (hardship/suffering). Structural cue: the negated-except form narrows the fire’s direct encounter to the most wretched. Mechanism: the path of hardship culminates in embodied contact with heat. Abductive move: I infer that “most wretched” names the fully realized endpoint of 92:10’s العسرى. Reading change: entry into fire is not arbitrary but path-completion.

2. **Prayer/blessing branch inverted.** Evidence: `ص ل ي` B001 (ritual prayer), B002 (supplication/blessing/mercy), activated by the basmalah mercy and 92:12 guidance. Structural cue: the same root can be worshipful relation or fire-contact. Mechanism: refusal of guided relation leaves only the heat-side of ṣ-l-y. Abductive move: I infer an inversion: missed prayerful alignment becomes compulsory exposure. Reading change: the ayah carries a relational loss beneath the punishment image.

3. **Follower just behind the leader.** Evidence: `ص ل ي` B007 (racer following just behind), activated by 92:7/10 facilitated paths and `ه د ي` B003 leading front. Structural cue: guidance and paths imply procession. Mechanism: the “ashqā” follows the wrong leader/trajectory until he reaches the fire. Abductive move: I infer race/procession imagery from path and facilitation cues. Reading change: يصلىها can imply entering as the trailing consequence of a chosen lead.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: 92:17-18 retrospectively fused the two verbs: the one who “gave and guarded” becomes “the most guarded” who gives wealth to purify himself. The surprise is that taqwā is not only interior caution; it becomes a spatial shield completed by divine removal from fire.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Exposure as the end of a practiced hardship.** `يَصْلَىٰهَا` anchors `ص ل ي:B003` (encountering fire and suffering its heat), and `ٱلْأَشْقَى` anchors `ش ق و:B002` (hardship, strenuous suffering, and practiced endurance). `ٱلْعُسْرَىٰ` in 92:10 supplies the direct hardship analogue, while falling, warning, denial, and turning in 92:11–16 give it a progressive history. The abductive move is that the superlative names a person formed through that course rather than an arbitrary label attached at exposure. The ayah reads as convergence between a cultivated hardship and its thermal encounter.

2. **Exploratory fire-straightening image.** `ص ل ي:B004` includes heating and turning a stick over fire to straighten it. Guidance in 92:12 and purification in 92:18 activate the neighboring ideas of direction and correction, while `لَا ... إِلَّا` sharply limits who meets this operation. The packet does not say the encounter reforms its subject; mapping the craft image onto exposure is therefore explicitly abductive, and `ص ل ي:B003` remains primary. Even so, the dormant branch makes the fire legible as a force that tests or manifests crookedness under heat, not only as undifferentiated pain.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Purification in 92:18 unexpectedly activated the craft image `ص ل ي:B004` of fire-straightening. Yet 92:16’s denial and 92:17’s avoidance correct an overreading: the packet does not say exposure reforms the subject, so the branch is retained only as an exploratory image of testing or manifesting crookedness.

findings.text: En bahtsız kişinin ateşle karşılaşması, önceki zorluk yolunda biçimlenen hayatın bedensel temasla tamamlanan uç noktasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü bir din topluluğunun kiliseleri, başka bir topluluğun tapınma yerleri ve daha genel olarak tapınma yeri adı şeklinde verir; sağlanan çerçeve bu çeşitliliği doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Eylemin kendisi değil, tapınmaya ayrılmış yer adlandırılır; topluluğa özgü kilise kullanımı genel yer anlamına bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız yalın yer adlarını içerir ve başka dallardaki tapınma eylemi ya da dilek anlamlarını tanıma katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun tapınmasına ayrılmış yerin adıdır; özellikle Yahudilerin kiliseleri için kullanılır, bazı anlatımlarda Sabiilerin tapınma yerlerini de kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir din topluluğunun topluca veya düzenli biçimde tapındığı yer adlandırılır.
Ad özellikle Yahudilerin kiliseleri için verilir; bazı anlatımlarda Sabiilerin tapınma yerlerine de uygulanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım sözcüğü tapınma yeri adı olarak açıklar; topluluğa özgü kullanım Yahudi kiliselerini öne çıkarırken başka bir aktarım Sabiilerin tapınma yerlerini de kapsar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel tapınma yeri anlamını ve özellikle belirli din topluluklarının kiliseleri için kullanılan yer adını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Tapınmaya ayrılmış yer çekirdeğini ve kilise olarak özelleşen kullanımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çoğul biçimin özellikle Yahudi topluluğunun kiliselerini adlandırdığı tarihsel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir topluluğa ait kiliseleri ve bunların tapınma yeri oluşunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel tapınma yeri anlamını ve Sabiilerin tapınma yerlerine uzanan aktarımı dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Yahudilerin kiliseleri veya bir din topluluğunun tapınma yerleri

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da tapınma yerini, özellikle Yahudilerin kiliselerini ve bazı anlatımlarda Sabiilerin tapınma yerlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Sunulan kartlar yer türü, topluluklara uzanım veya eylem ile yer ayrımı bakımından bir sınır farkı göstermez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi geniş bir dövme taşını, üzerinde güzel kokulu maddelerin veya kurutulmuş yemişin dövülmesini ve taşın kaba, kalın bir levha görünümünü açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, malzemenin üstünde dövüldüğü geniş taş yüzeyidir; genel olarak her taş veya her dövme aracı kastedilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın taş adlarıyla sınırlıdır; ateş, tapınma, anatomi veya yalnız başka bir araçta görülen dövme anlamları içeri alınmaz.

Nesne kaba ve kalın bir taş levha görünümüyle de betimlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, üzerinde malzeme dövülen geniş taşı tanımlar; güzel kokulu madde ve kurutulmuş yemiş örneklerini verir ve taşın kaba, kalın yüzeyini belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Malzemenin içine değil üstüne konup dövüldüğü geniş, sert ve çoğu kez kaba taş yüzeyi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Taşın malzemeyi dövüp ezmeye ayrılmış bir çalışma yüzeyi olmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da güzel kokulu madde veya kurutulmuş yemiş gibi malzemelerin üstünde dövüldüğü geniş ve kaba taşı tanımlar.

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.
